messages.author: fd4f3538f907404b
messages.subject: "NOTSIMULATE" macro?
parts: For something I'm doing right now it would be convenient to have a block of C++ code that only ran when *not* in simulation mode. Is there an easy/obvious way to do this?

messages.author: 258b98968d0ad8b9
messages.subject: Re: "NOTSIMULATE" macro?
parts:
The SIMULATE macro is defined by:

#define SIMULATE if(isDouble<Type>::value && TMB_OBJECTIVE_PTR -> do_simulate)

So you could define e.g.

#define NOTSIMULATE if(isDouble<Type>::value && !TMB_OBJECTIVE_PTR -> do_simulate)
